# Campaign results — pooled per run (generated by render_results.py)

Campaign `meas-ci:interactive:6` and `meas-ci:playback:6` (VS Code: `interactive:8`; Chrome: `interactive:9`; their first batches superseded — changelog D25; `chrome` pooled with `--exclude-roles renderer`, D14), 2026-09-16/17, single-core (pin.sh; method §4). Numbers are pooled over the run's repeats (five 605 s driven, 605 s driven-alt, 120 s idle, 600 s op or 300 s play phases unless stated); `spread` is the range of the per-repeat p50. Threads are the top five by CPU. Per-input rules are method §5's (a) first-wake, (b) window minus idle rate, (c) waker (X-server-woken schedule-ins). Runner: `ubuntu-24.04`, 4 vCPU, kernel per `reports/*.spec.json`.
